> Yo! For Week 5 Freestyle, I'm designing the Cyber Log Pose—a pocket-sized universal IR remote cloner and Wi-Fi scanner shaped like the Straw Hat Jolly Roger. It runs on an ESP32-C3 SuperMini with an OLED screen, built under $30 with domestic parts. Let's build it!
